commits.content:
# Pre-commit hooks configuration for Pelican site
# Setup: uv pip install pre-commit && pre-commit install
# Run manually: pre-commit run --all-files

# Global exclusions to prevent scanning generated files or virtual environments
exclude: ^(output/|\.venv/|venv/|__pycache__/|node_modules/|vendor/)

repos:
  # General file checks
  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    rev: v6.0.0
    hooks:
      - id: trailing-whitespace
        name: Trim trailing whitespace
      - id: end-of-file-fixer
        name: Fix end of files
      - id: check-yaml
        name: Check YAML syntax
      - id: check-added-large-files
        args: ['--maxkb=1000']
      - id: check-case-conflict
      - id: check-merge-conflict
      - id: mixed-line-ending
        args: ['--fix=lf']
      - id: check-json

  # Markdown linting
  - repo: https://github.com/igorshubovych/markdownlint-cli
    rev: v0.47.0
    hooks:
      - id: markdownlint
        name: Lint Markdown files
        args: [--config, .markdownlint.json]
        files: \.md$

  # YAML linting
  - repo: https://github.com/adrienverge/yamllint
    rev: v1.37.1
    hooks:
      - id: yamllint
        name: Lint YAML files
        args: ['-c', '.yamllint.yml']

  # Check for common spelling mistakes
  - repo: https://github.com/codespell-project/codespell
    rev: v2.4.1
    hooks:
      - id: codespell
        name: Check spelling
        args: ['--ignore-words=.codespell-ignore.txt']
        exclude: ^(package(-lock)?\.json|LICENSE|CNAME)$
